brief: Priority 1 is to enter at map reference (29.64760, -89.96118) closest to 9 isolated buildings [F3]. 9 buildings are isolated, cut off from every exit road, with 0 uncertain, 0 still reachable, 0 with no mapped road nearby [F2]. 48 road pieces were checked: 5 judged flooded, 25 uncertain, the rest judged dry [F1]. In testing on 20 SpaceNet 8 tiles 1 of 666 truly cut-off buildings was marked reachable, with an 'isolated' call right roughly 4 to 5 in 10 where most buildings could still get out and 98 in 100 where nearly all were cut off depending on the area, so treat 'isolated' as a reason to check, not a confirmed cut-off [F4]. Flood judgements come from a vision model reading satellite photos, are not field-verified, and uncertain roads need a drone or ground check [F5].
